integrity: All hypotheses, branches, exact valuation identities and proof limitations are explicit. Independent audit was not conducted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers odd inputs to the self-power map modulo powers of two, but neither even inputs nor odd prime powers nor generalized exponents. Numerical tests at finitely many moduli do not replace the all-exponent proof. Historical priority has not been independently certified.
title: Complete dyadic orbit lengths of the odd self-power permutation
